=== ABOUT ===
About Us

Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar University

Formerly Known As Agra University

[]

[]

The foundation – of Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar University (originally known as
Agra University) was laid on the 1st of July, 1927, as a result of
hectic efforts of a band of enthusiastic educationists like Rev. Canon
A.W. Davis, Munshi Narain Prasad Asthana, Dr L.P. Mathur, Lala Dewan
Chand, Rai Bahadur Anand Swaroop and Dr Brajendra Swaroop,.

Original jurisdiction of University extended over United Provinces of
Agra, Central India and Rajputana with 14 affiliated colleges and 2530
students of which, 1475 students belonged to United Provinces.
Initially, there were only four faculties in the University viz. Arts,
Sciences, Commerce and Law. Faculties of Medicine (1936), Agriculture
(1938), Home Science (1980), Basic Sciences (1981), Fine Arts (1982) and
Management (1994) were added subsequently.

A decisive characteristic in influencing the education of an academic
institution is the pursuit of excellence and consistent adherence to a
high standard in terms of imparting knowledge promoting research. 

During the last eighty-three years, the University has endeavored to
keep adopting these high ideas and has established rich traditions and
evolved respect from the intellectual community. University has
sincerely served the cause of higher education in northern India. The
ancient principle of integrating ethical and moral values in education
has been the endeavor of the University. To inculcate these essential
values in its students academicians have been assiduously trying to
sharpen the content and curriculum of the University.

The Agra University, Agra was renamed as Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar University,
Agra from 24.09.1995 vide U.P. Govt. Notification No.
33/XVII-V-1-1(ka)-43-1996, dated 06.01.1996). The University now caters
to the educational need of the seven districts of Agra Division Agra,
Aligarh, Mainpuri, Hathras, Firozabad, Etah and Mathura. Besides, the
University is proud of having affiliated to it, Sarojini Naidu Medical
College, which is one of the oldest and premier Medical Institute of the
country. At present university has approx 200 affiliated colleges and 15
residential Institutes spread out in its four residential campus viz.
Paliwal Park, Khandari Campus, Civil Lines Campus and Chhaleshar Campus.
Furthermore, this university affiliates colleges of Homeopathy,
extending all over the State of U.P.

The University is steadily surging ahead as a centre for higher
scientific vocational and job oriented education and innovative
research. The goal of the University is to innovate in the field of
education and to become a centre of excellence both Nationally and
Internationally. The University is not only confined to impart quality
education but also to satisfy the burning desire of the students who are
exploring the creative intellect and learning attitude of the students.
The University is making every effort to fulfill the spirit of
University motto “Tamso Ma Jyotirgamay” moving from darkness to light.

                                            Introduction

Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Agra, Uttar Pradesh, with Hon’ble Mrs. Anandiben Patel as its
Chancellor, is a prestigious academic institution known for its educational excellence, social awareness,
and progressive outlook. Its motto – "Tamaso Ma Jyotirgamaya" – symbolizes not only the
attainment of knowledge and liberation from ignorance but also conveys a universal message of truth,
justice, and guidance.

Established on 1st July 1927, it is one of the oldest educational institutions in North India. Initially, its
jurisdiction extended over parts of Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Punjab, Rajasthan, Northern Madhya
Pradesh, and Western Bihar. In 1996, the university was renamed in honor of the architect of the
Indian Constitution as Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University. Presently, its jurisdiction spans four
districts of Uttar Pradesh – Agra, Mathura, Firozabad, and Mainpuri.

The university's foundation was supported by many distinguished individuals, including the first Vice-
Chancellor Sir William Skillbeck Martin and Deputy Vice-Chancellor Reverend Canon A.W. Dev.
Prominent national figures such as former Presidents Dr. Shankar Dayal Sharma, Mr. Ram Nath
Kovind, and former Prime Minister Mr. Atal Bihari Vajpayee received education here. Other notable
personalities associated with the university include thinker Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay, National
Security Advisor Mr. Ajit Doval, literary figures such as Mr. Raghe Yadav and Dr. Nagendra, and
scientific pioneers like Prof. Narendra Singh Kapany and Dr. Ganesh Prasad Pandey. Their
contributions have not only achieved greatness in their respective fields but also brought honor and
recognition to the university.

The university structure includes four major residential campuses: Paliwal Park, Swami Vivekananda
Swami Vivekanand Campus, Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Chalesar Campus, and Sanskriti
Bhawan Civil Lines Campus, where high-quality academic activities and classes are conducted. The
Swami Vivekanand campus has two hostels specifically for female students, while the Chalesar campus
houses a male hostel. The university is affiliated with 14 government colleges, 27 aided colleges, and
540 self-financed colleges.
 Various academic institutions under the university include:

   •   University Computer Centre, Swami Vivekanand Campus
   •   Institute of Basic Science, Swami Vivekanand Campus
   •   Institute of Engineering & Technology, Swami Vivekanand Campus
